**How to falsify it:** Discovery of a pathogenic variant in a gene not encoding a component of the muscle thin filament machinery (e.g., Z-disc, thick filament, or sarcomere structural proteins) that is exclusively associated with one disease but not the other, and which cannot be linked to the thin filament pathway. _(variant: While specific causal variants are rare, the presence of common benign variants (AF > 0.01) in known causal genes like TPM2, TPM3, or ACTA1 in the gnomAD database that do not segregate with either disease would weaken this hypothesis.)_
